entries.name: The Ship
entries.content:
The abandoned mega-cruise that {{char}} and {{user}} woke up in mysteriously.
It has 5 decks;
- Deck 1, The highest deck, also known as the balcony deck, or the VIP deck. This deck is a large platform mounted above the water park on Deck 2, the VIP Deck has a bar, a lounge, a pool, and a hottub, it was typically reserved for the highest paying customers, or any sort of VIPs.
- Deck 2, 'The main floor'. This is the main deck that is exposed to the air. It has 2 water parks, one for all ages, and one specifically for kids. It has 3 restaurants, 2 bars, 3 clothing stores, and a large Pool, which is inside a large glass dome. It also has many lounge areas scattered around. There is also an open-air concert area near the pool dome. There are many flights of stairs connecting to the main deck from lower decks. Every restaurant, bar, and store on The main deck has a direct staircase inside from the deck below.
- Deck 3, The 'everything' deck. This is the deck that split into 3 sections. Section 1 is comprised almost entirely by food courts, restaurants, and bars. The food courts have many fast-food places and take-out places, but the restaurants are larger, independant buildings all equipped with seating areas, an ordering counter, and a kitchen. The bars are all similar, in which they have a couple tables, but mostly the bar seating, and a small kitchen behind the bar. Section 2 is all the stores; any store you can think of that would be on a cruise, and it's probably there. It's similar to a large shopping mall. Section 3 is concert venues and convention centers, they're all mostly similar.
- Deck 4, the hotel deck. The hotel deck is comprised of all the hotels and employee housing on the cruise. There are 4 independant hotels, and 1 hotel that is completely dedicated to cruise employees. The hotels are similar to each other, but they all have different themes, colorschemes, and lobbies.
- Deck 5, the bottom most deck, The maintenance deck. It's a maze-like construct of pipes, engines, gears, everything that keeps the cruise running. There's not much reason to be down here except for monitoring and maintenance. The captain's rooms are located here.

entries.content: The main pool building, which is located on the Deck 2/Main Deck, toward the back of the ship. It is a large glass dome building, which houses 2 large public pools, 2 small pools for children, 6 hot tubs, and 5 life-guard towers. There are seats and unbrellas located at the sides of each pool.

entries.content: There are 2 water parks, located on Deck 2/The main deck. 1 is for all ages, the 2nd is specifically for kids and pre-teens. They are located at the front of the ship.

entries.name: Stores
entries.content: There are many stores/shops on the ship. Anything that you could think of that you'd need on a cruise; there's a shop for it. There are many clothing shops, swimwear shops, hat shops, sunglasses shops, footwear shops, underwear shops, snack shops, pharmacies, medical supply stores, gift shops, etc.

entries.content: There are 2 small hospitals on the main deck, 1 at the back of the ship, and 1 at the front. There are smaller medical supply units scattered across each deck.
